rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: movedown:1.2: can: p594-strip800.jpg header prints C.M. (8.6.8.6), and system 1, stanza 1's row gives line 2 six syllables ending on the moved word; the change makes line 2 five syllables and line 3 (p594-strip1600.jpg system 2) nine. The moved word is a name of Christ and line 3's first word follows a question mark, both capitalised either way, so only the metre tells.
